scenes.narration_context: Two friends, Rakib and Suman, both earn 30 thousand taka.
scenes.visual_concept: Title card with two flat vector characters in side-by-side cards, each carrying the same salary chip so the equal starting point is obvious.
graphic_elements: Two character cards: রাকিব (green) and সুমন (coral)
Salary chip on both cards: বেতন ৩০,০০০ টাকা
scenes.animation_direction: Header rises in first, cards stagger up 8 frames apart, characters pop with a soft spring and breathe gently.

scenes.narration_context: Ten years later Rakib has 14 lakh taka, Suman only 80 thousand.
scenes.visual_concept: Full-width comparison panel with two horizontal money bars: Rakib's bar fills the panel, Suman's stays a sliver. The gap is labelled.
scenes.animation_direction: Rakib's bar sweeps to 100% with a spring, Suman's bar crawls to 6%, numbers fade in as each bar passes 60% of its travel.

scenes.narration_context: The difference is one habit: Suman spends first and saves whatever is left.
scenes.visual_concept: Centered typographic reveal — পার্থক্য? then একটি অভ্যাস। with a gold underline — followed by Suman's two-step flow.
graphic_elements: Flow chips: আগে খরচ → পরে যা থাকে জমা
scenes.animation_direction: Question fades up, answer scales in, underline draws left to right, then the flow chips swipe in and the arrow draws itself.

scenes.narration_context: Rakib moves 20% to investments within ten minutes of payday.
scenes.visual_concept: Salary card with a segmented bar; the green 20% segment grows first and an arrow sends it to an investment label.
scenes.animation_direction: Card enters from left, the green segment grows to 20% with a damped spring, arrow draws toward the right-hand explanation.

scenes.narration_context: Then he spends the rest. This is called pay yourself first; give yourself money first.
scenes.visual_concept: Statement scene: the English habit name as hero type with a Bengali one-line explanation in a numbered card.
graphic_elements: Line: তারপর বাকি টাকা দিয়ে খরচ
Explainer card: নিজেকে আগে টাকা দিন
scenes.animation_direction: Text lines rise sequentially; the numbered card slides up and settles; chip pops last.

scenes.narration_context: Six thousand taka a month at 12% return becomes 14 lakh in ten years.
scenes.visual_concept: Three factor cards multiplied together, then a navy result banner where the total counts up to 14,00,000 with the invested amount beside it.
graphic_elements: Caption: একই ৬,০০০ টাকা — শুধু আগে আলাদা করার অভ্যাস
scenes.animation_direction: Factors enter left to right, result banner scales in, number counts up from zero over ~1.5s.

scenes.narration_context: Of that, seven lakh is only the magic of compounding.
scenes.visual_concept: Growth chart comparing contributions and total value; the green area between the lines is the compounding gain.
graphic_elements: Headline: এর মধ্যে ৭ লাখ শুধু কম্পাউন্ডিংয়ের জাদু
Legend: নীল রেখা = জমানো টাকা, সবুজ এলাকা = মোট মূল্য
scenes.animation_direction: Chart draws left to right behind a clip rect; headline and chips arrive first so the eye knows what to read.

scenes.narration_context: Set an auto transfer in the bank app tonight; it takes ten minutes.
scenes.visual_concept: Phone mockup of a bank app with the auto-transfer toggle flipping on, next to the call to action.
graphic_elements: Headline: আজ রাতেই অটো ট্রান্সফার সেট করুন
Phone mockup with ৳ ৬,০০০ monthly auto transfer
Chips: ১০ মিনিট লাগবে / একবারই সেট করতে হবে
scenes.animation_direction: Headline rises, phone slides up and tilts straight, the toggle knob slides right on the click beat.

scenes.narration_context: Ten minutes now; ten years will change.
scenes.visual_concept: Short contrast card: ১০ মিনিট arrow ১০ বছর with the payoff line underneath.
scenes.animation_direction: Numbers rise from opposite sides, the gold underline draws, payoff line fades in.

scenes.narration_context: Follow, and the next video will cover where to invest.
scenes.visual_concept: Outro card with follow CTA and a preview strip for the next video topic.
graphic_elements: Chips: পেই ইওরসেলফ ফার্স্ট / আজই শুরু করুন
Next-video strip: পরের ভিডিও: টাকা কোথায় বিনিয়োগ করবেন?
scenes.animation_direction: Headline first, chips pop in, then the next-video strip slides up; holds to the final frame.
scenes.transition: swipe cut, no fade to black
